name: Add `rowbly skills install`
description:
Users that use rowbly have two options for skills:

- Import pre-built skills
- Create their own skills


I want a command that allows users to import pre-built skills for rowbly into their project. For this I want to introduce one command and update an existing:

- `rowbly skills install`: Installs a new skill, can either be run with <path_to_skill> OR when run by itself it will show a menu of skills available for install. Clack prompts should be used for menu
- `rowbly skills list`: Update this command to list out two sections: official skills and custom skills

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 3 (one development agent, no separate research or validation agent). Branch claude/row-20-skills-install, built on ROW-18's skills command group. Plan: add `rowbly skills install [path]` (with no path, a Clack menu of the official skills shipped in the package; copies into the --harness skills folder), split `rowbly skills list` into Official and Custom sections (text and --json), and update the user guide and skill references. No new tests, per AGENTS.md. Validation is the four repository checks, a manual run and agentic-tui screenshots.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/100 (depends on ROW-18's PR #99; land after it). Adds `rowbly skills install [path|official-name] [--harness]` with a Clack menu of official skills when run with no path, and splits `rowbly skills list` into Official skills and Custom skills (JSON {official, custom}). Validation: typecheck, lint, test:unit (66) and test:cli (20) pass; manual runs of the built CLI cover menu, name and path installs and every exit code; agentic-tui screenshots are on the PR. The Board has no review Stage, so the Story stays in In Progress.
